logic: The verification proof a receipt carries in its QR code and its PDF link (plan v3 D5 to D7, slice 1.5): one form for every receipt, every gift always. An encoding case names a receipt (input.receipt), the key that signs it (signingKeyId, one of input.keys; the backend signs with the RFC 8032 test 1 seed its tests hold, never a key of a server) and the foundation's IČO. The backend writes the body (payloadHex, big-endian): format 0x01; the key id, the first 4 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key; flags, bit 0 yearly, bit 1 a company, bit 2 replaces an earlier receipt, bit 3 the postal code in the Czech form NNN NN, bits 4 to 7 zero; the serial of the number as u24, its year being the year of issue; the issue day as u16 days since 2000-01-01; a yearly receipt's year as u16; a replaced receipt's serial as u24 and its issue day as u16; the donor's name, street and city as a LEB128 byte length and NFC UTF-8; the postal code as u24 under bit 3, else as text; a company's IČO as u32; the number of gifts as LEB128; each gift as its day (u16, days not decreasing) and its amount in hellers (LEB128); the total in hellers (LEB128). It signs with Ed25519 the ASCII tag nfnn.cz/receipt/v1, one zero byte, the foundation's IČO as u32 and the body (signatureHex; signedSha256 is the SHA-256 of that signed message), appends the 64-byte signature to the body and writes the bytes in chunks of 7 as decimal numbers of 17 digits, a last chunk of k bytes in 3, 5, 8, 10, 13 or 15 digits, after https://nfnn.cz/overit#1 (qrText). The symbol (qr) is a byte segment for https://nfnn.cz/overit# and a numeric segment for the rest, error correction M up to version 13 and L from version 14, the smallest version that holds both; above version 40 (2 893 bytes) there is none and issuance is refused as donations/receipt-too-long. The browser reads every encoding case's qrText against input.keys and gets the verdict valid with keyId signingKeyId and the receipt input.receipt. A reading case gives a qrText made by hand, and both sides read it to its expected verdict, checking in this order: the prefix https://nfnn.cz/overit#1 (not-a-proof); only digits whose count a chunk width gives, each chunk below 2 to the power of 8 times its bytes (digits); no bytes, or fewer than 70 once the format byte is 0x01 (truncated); the format byte (unknown-format); the key id among input.keys (unknown-key) and not revoked (revoked-key); the Ed25519 signature of the last 64 bytes over the tag, the IČO and the rest, refused when S is not below the group order (bad-signature); then the body: bits 4 to 7 (reserved-flags), a field running past the body (truncated), a LEB128 number with a needless last zero group (non-minimal-varint), text that is empty, not UTF-8 or not NFC (invalid-text), a serial outside 1 to 999 999, a year before 2000, a postal code above 99 999, an IČO above 99 999 999, a LEB128 number of more than eight groups or of 2 to the power of 53 or more, no gift or a single receipt of more than one, a day before the gift's predecessor, an amount of zero or a yearly gift outside its year (invalid-value), bytes after the total (trailing-bytes), a total other than the sum of the gifts (total-mismatch).
